text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, received the following petition for information: 1. Petition regarding adding houses on Fairway Drive, Braeburn Boulevard and Ceder Brae Boulevard to the Mechanical Leaf Pick-up program, submitted by Councillor Michael Thompson, Ward 21, Scarborough Centre, containing the signatures of approximately 43 persons.
